scope: Public summary of recorded local verification. Original private device logs, save snapshots and coordinator records are excluded; this metadata is not a new test run.
native_touch: Actual normal dispatch, route, curb pickup/delivery, receipt, daily gift, engine purchase and Back navigation were reviewed with same-PID Godot error guards. Offline completion is separately saved and bound to this capture run.
interstitial: One actual test interstitial presented after the second delivered fare in the same process and was dismissed; saved paid receipt and normal navigation returned.

reward.claim_limit: One saved boolean entitlement is consumed by the next completed fare; no persistent ad receipt or unique round ID is claimed.
reward.negative_attempt: First test-ad pod displayed black media and closed without an earned callback; all24 saved groups stayed unchanged. The second real media attempt earned once and saved the entitlement.

back.behavior: Subpage Back returns Home; Home Back is a no-op with the same process and all24 groups preserved. No Android exit is claimed.

limits: Official Google test IDs only; production IDs/backend/consent/signing/store setup remain owner work.
One API30 emulator with physical1080x1920 framebuffer and logical tablet overrides; no physical-device acceptance.
The first black test-ad pod did not earn; a subsequent real media attempt did. No broad ad-fill/reliability claim.
Short QA does not establish every passenger/car/upgrade, long-term economy, midnight rollover, seven-day streak or many-session reliability.
Hosted CI/Pages and production Play Games integration remain separate; no external publication is established.
The emulator uses -no-audio; audible Android sound remains unverified.
audio_and_browser_qualification: Emulator audio disabled; audible output, interactive browser/WebGL and physical-device acceptance remain unverified. Production services and human balance remain owner work.
